notes.title: 1.0.1: VR Improvements
notes.content:
Quick patch today with some VR improvements:
[list]
[*] Added a better skybox and floor for VR modes to improve immersion
[*] Added ability to raise/lower puzzle (Options -> VR Setings -> VR Height)
[*] Scale option is now exposed in VR Settings rather than secret keys
[*] UI contrast improved for VR UI elements
[/list]
